headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of August 3, 2026, the portfolio set has achieved an average return of 22.64%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark, which returned 11.74%. This outperformance is indicative of the portfolio's strength during a period that may involve market stress or macroeconomic uncertainty. The average alpha of 10.91% further emphasizes that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a remarkable return of 44.32%, driven by its strongest holding, PANW, which has returned 121.58%. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 15.88%, with its bottom holding, ALB, showing a decline of 24.32%. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
